Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
As a Lead Cyber Security Engineer you will drive the design, acquisition, and deployment of hardware, software, and network infrastructure in close coordination with the broader Technology team. Your primary objective is to ensure that existing and planned security frameworks meet the highest quality and compliance standards.
 In this role, you will define highly scalable, integrated security architectures, influence product roadmaps, and drive interoperability across a complex end-to-end network and cloud security ecosystem, always keeping the client experience at the forefront.
 Responsibilities 
 Strategic Collaboration: Partner with Transformation Program Directors, Senior Architects, Steering Committees, CISO, and CTI partners to successfully deliver complex, enterprise-wide transformational programs.
 Segmentation Engineering: Collaborate with Citi’s Cyber Security Lab, Architecture, and Engineering teams to design, deploy, and maintain robust VMWare vDefend Security Controls and micro-segmentation solutions.
 Governance & Relationship Management: Interface with and support Citi’s Security Architecture Council and Working Groups, building strong rapport and alignment across cross-functional teams.
 Digital Transformation: Support Citi’s adoption of the cloud continuum and holistic digital transformation initiatives.
 Automation & Scripting: Develop automation scripts (using Python, Shell, etc.) to streamline repetitive operational tasks, including software installations/upgrades, database patching, OS patching, and server provisioning.
 Project & Incident Management: Formulate comprehensive project plans, conduct thorough impact analyses, and troubleshoot high-impact, complex technical issues to ensure rapid service restoration.
 Requirements 
Strong Illumio knowledge and Engeneering skills 
 For more information – please apply for this job or send your CV directly to cristiana@cavendishprofessionals.com
